subject: Tailings impoundment of the Escondida copper mine complex, Atacama Desert, Chile. Per NASA's caption the open pits lie to the north and are not shown. Taken in 2009; it does not depict the proposed New Concentrator.

processing.crop_note: 4:5 crop centred on the liquid-tailings pond and the retaining dam; excludes the catalogue label strip
processing.caption_scrim: sRGB values multiplied by a smoothstep ramp from 1.0 at y=1900 px to 0.62 at y=2080 px, held to the bottom edge (numpy 2.5.4, rounded to nearest). Without it the slide caption measured about 4.0:1 against the composited photo; with it the worst pixel under the caption box measures 5.1:1 against #B5AE9F.

considered_and_rejected.what: ASTER scene of the Escondida pits, 23 April 2000
considered_and_rejected.why: Credited NASA/GSFC/METI/ERSDAC/JAROS; the JPL image-use policy says material owned by parties other than NASA/JPL may carry commercial-use restrictions, so it is not cleanly public domain.
Released only as video with no still frames.
